1.21.1.0.1767.0:
**Menus & UI ×2 · New Feature ×1 · Bug Fix ×1 · Editor ×1 · Community ×1**

### 0.1766.0

**Free Play is off by default**

Your own train designs no longer switch on by themselves. Every new world starts on the built-in trains, without Free Play, unless you turn your designs on with the button beside New World, and only then are you asked to confirm. Just opening the Train Editor no longer counts as changing anything.

- New worlds start without Free Play by default, with no popup
- Turning your designs on still asks you to confirm each new world
- Opening the Train Editor, or a vault's loot menu, no longer puts runs into Free Play
- Runs that count for your stats are now called Ranked

### 0.1765.0

**Live effect**

A new Live effect shows while you're streaming with the Live Eye, and your status effects now sit just below the stream box instead of hiding behind it.
1.21.1.0.1764.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Bug Fix ×2 · Community ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · World ×1 · Mobs ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1763.0

**The patchwork stretch shows more**

Late in the journey, the patchwork of floating ground now draws on every kind of place you have passed, each wearing its own scenery. Some patches hold a ruined building.

### 0.1762.0

**Drifting effect**

A new Drifting effect shows while you're inside a drifting carriage, so you know the train will remember the changes you make there.

### 0.1760.0

**Freeze fix**

Fixed a rare freeze where the train, mobs and chests suddenly stopped while you could still look around and move. It could happen when a mob in a carriage room went for a wander.

**Startup crash fix**

Fixed a crash when loading a world that could happen on Windows after the game had previously crashed or was still running in the background.
1.21.1.0.1760.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Loot ×1 · Menus & UI ×1 · Balance ×1**

### 0.1760.0

**Gear sells for what it's worth**

Villagers now pay for gear and enchanted books by how good they are. Better stats, better rolls and stronger enchantments sell for more, and netherite no longer sells for far more than diamond. Expensive trades can ask for more than two stacks, with extra payment slots.

- Sell prices follow damage, armour, durability and enchantments
- Netherite gear sells for about twice diamond, not over ten times
- Mending and Silk Touch are worth much more
- Big trades show extra payment slots, four to a row, scrolling past twelve
1.21.1.0.1759.0:
**Bug Fix ×4 · Loot ×4 · New Feature ×3 · Balance ×3 · New Content ×2 · Editor ×2 · Compatibility ×2 · Menus & UI ×2 · Mobs ×1 · Advancements ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1758.0

**Support tooling fix**

Behind-the-scenes improvements to how we help players who lose a run to a bug.

### 0.1757.0

**Low storage warning**

The game now warns you when your drive is nearly full, before it runs out of space and crashes mid-run.

- A warning pops up when your drive has less than 5 GB free, so you can clear space before it becomes a problem.
- Under 1 GB free, a red warning repeats every couple of minutes telling you to save and quit.
- Server owners get the same warning for the server's drive.

**Smite works on every zombie and skeleton**

Smite now deals its bonus damage to all zombies and skeletons, not just the classic ones. Healing and Harming potions also work on them the right way round.

### 0.1755.0

**Farmer's Delight**

Farmer's Delight is no longer an approved mod. Runs with it installed are Free Play, because its food and drinks give advantages a normal run doesn't have.

### 0.1754.0

**Vault gear rebalance**

Gear from regular and ominous vaults gets a gentle boost, and the rarest vault's gear is now always the strongest of the three, however far down the line you are.

- The rarest vault now always beats an ominous vault at the same spot.

### 0.1753.0

**Stronger gear from the rarest vault**

Weapons and armour from the rarest vault now come out far stronger, rolled as if found much deeper down the line. Vault rewards have also been reshuffled, with bigger piles of the good stuff.

- Rarest vault gear hits much harder and protects much better.
- Rarest and ominous vault rewards rebalanced.

### 0.1752.0

**Editor: pre-filled loot containers**

Builders can now set up loot that comes out already packed with its own roll of items.

### 0.1751.0

**Photo collection fix**

Photo collections now show the photo you already took of a mob, and name every mob you've already counted. Collections that were finished without their photos need those photos taken again.

**Potion loot tweak**

Random potions found on the train are a little different
1.21.1.0.1750.0:
**Loot ×2 · Balance ×2 · New Content ×1 · Bug Fix ×1**

### 0.1749.0

**More keys in chests and pots**

Trial Keys and Ominous Trial Keys turn up more often in chests, pots and vases.

### 0.1748.0

**Mending fix**

Small improvement to how mending is found
1.21.1.0.1747.0:
# More Mobs Creeping Aboard

![More Mobs Creeping Aboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/carriage-newcomers.gif)

Several new faces join the line, some of you may recognise them. Not all will be so scary, but as the train gets deeper that will change.

**New Feature ×6 · Balance ×5 · Loot ×4 · Editor ×2 · Train ×2 · Mobs ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · World ×1 · Advancements ×1**

### 0.1746.0

**Terra Omnia rare biomes tweak**

Ominous Woods is now one of Terra Omnia's rare biomes and turns up more often. Terra Omnia now asks for any 3 of the 6 rare biomes.

### 0.1743.0

**Librarian trade tweak**

Librarians who take up a new job now offer a slightly different selection of books.

**Better books from the rarest vault**

The rarest vault can now hand out several powerful enchanted books at once, and something new.

- Books from the rarest vault carry several strong enchantments, never a curse.
- Builders can set how many random enchantments a book in their loot gets, and an enchanted book added from the hand keeps its own.

### 0.1740.0

**Mending trades limited to a few**

Villagers and other traders who sell Mending now only have one to three in stock at a time.

**Dimensional carriage fix**

Water no longer leaks into dimensional carriages.

**Train villagers no longer restock**

Villagers on the train keep the stock they start with. Once a trade sells out, it stays sold out.

### 0.1726.0

**Rooms fit their carriage**

Decorations at the edges of a carriage room now take the carriage around them into account, so things hang from real ceilings and sit on real floors.

- Room decorations along the walls, floor and ceiling now follow the carriage they are in
1.21.1.0.1739.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Community ×1 · Loot ×1 · Books ×1 · Menus & UI ×1 · Balance ×1**

### 0.1739.0

**Vault reward tweak**

Vault rewards have been rebalanced.

### 0.1738.0

**Report lectern letters**

Letters written by other players can now be reported from the lectern they sit on. The report button is on the last page of the letter, and reporting one letter reports its whole series.
1.21.1.0.1737.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Menus & UI ×2 · Community ×1**

### 0.1737.0

**Update help**

The new version prompt has a small ? button that shows how to update for the launcher you play on, with a download button and a shortcut to your mods folder where you update by hand.

- Your builds, unlocks and stats are kept whichever way you update.

### 0.1735.0

**Stream logos**

When you go live with the Live Eye, the chat now shows a row of logos for everywhere the stream can be watched. Click one to open it.

- Dungeon Train, Twitch, YouTube and Kick logos, each a link
- Hover a logo to see where it goes
1.21.1.0.1735.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Editor ×1 · Loot ×1 · Balance ×1**

### 0.1735.0

**Richer rewards from the rarest vault**

The rarest vault's best rewards now arrive in generous piles instead of the odd one or two, it can hand out something new, and its rarest prizes stay just as rare. Vault rewards that don't stack now pay out every item they roll.

- Bigger stacks of the good stuff from the rarest vault.
- Something new to find in the rarest vault.
- Fewer bulk blocks, more treasure.
- Builders can now set a smallest stack size for any loot.

### 0.1732.0

**Crash fix**

Fixed a rare crash while riding the train.

### 0.1731.0

**Photo collection fix**

Some photos you had already taken were not counting toward every collection they belong to. They do now, including photos taken before this update.

### 0.1730.0

**Luck pays off at vaults**

Luck now works on vaults too: with Luck I a vault gives you about one and a half times its usual reward, and with Luck II or stronger it doubles.

### 0.1729.0

**Death message language fix**

Death messages in languages other than English now read cleanly, without stray English words.

### 0.1726.0

**Kick chat in the Live chat**

Messages from the official stream's Kick chat now show in the in-game Live chat with a Kick icon, and every Live chat line shows an icon for where it came from.

Photos of some hostile mobs now say in chat which collection they count toward, like other photos do.

Trees and plants on one of the stranger stretches of the journey no longer stop dead in straight lines, which left some patches of ground looking bare beside overgrown ones. Only ground generated after updating changes.
1.21.1.0.1715.0:
# Free Live Eye translations

![Free Live Eye translations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/free-live-eye-translations.jpg)

Live Eye chat is now translated for everyone for free while free credits last, thanks to Brennan. Gifting Live Translations can start higher quality AI translations right away, or wait until the free credits run out.

**New Feature ×3 · Performance ×2 · Community ×2 · Loot ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Editor ×1 · Train ×1 · World ×1 · Mobs ×1**

### 0.1711.0

**Loyalty tridents always come back**

A thrown Loyalty trident now always finds its way home, even when the train carries you far away, you head through a portal, or it falls into the void. If your inventory is full it lands at your feet.

**Rare vault finds are remembered**

The rarest rewards in vaults are now counted across every passenger. Pull one that nobody has ever pulled before and you will be told you are the first. Rare finds from the tougher vaults also carry their number, who pulled them and the date.

- Be the first passenger ever to pull a rare vault reward and you will hear about it
- Rare finds from the tougher vaults show which number they are, who pulled them and when

### 0.1708.0

**Smoother world generation**

Another stretch of the journey now prepares new ground ahead of the train, so riding into it should stutter much less.

**Passenger log fix**

Deaths and echo encounters now reach the passenger log even if the connection drops for a moment. They may just arrive a little late.

### 0.1705.0

**Editor: choose the ground level for Endless Open**

Endless Open dimensional carriages in the editor can now choose which level repeats as the ground.

- Pick the room's bottom, the level at your feet, or the level the door sits on
- Tick Everything below to fill in the levels under it, or leave it off for open air

### 0.1704.0

**Mob crowds cross between carriages faster on CurseForge**

On CurseForge, crowds of mobs bunch up far less where two carriages meet, so they reach you sooner.
1.21.1.0.1704.0:
# Bow Stats

![Bow Stats](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/bow-stats.png)

Bows and crossbows now get stronger as you go deeper into the train.

**New Feature ×1 · Community ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1703.0

**See where your Live chat messages reached**

Your own Live chat messages now show a small flag for each language they were translated into. Hover a flag to read your message in that language.

- Translated messages now show on their own for everyone. Hover a message's flag for the original, or click the message to flip between the two.
- Your chat translation setting goes back to translation only once. You can change it in Options.
1.21.1.0.1702.0:
**Performance ×2 · New Feature ×1 · Train ×1 · World ×1 · Menus & UI ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1702.0

**Smoother world generation**

One of the stranger stretches of the journey now generates new ground much faster, so the long freezes as you ride into it should be far rarer. A few caves in newly generated ground may come out slightly differently.

### 0.1701.0

**Clearer lag reports**

Bug reports now say more about what caused a slow moment, so lag can be tracked down faster.

### 0.1699.0

**Fewer long freezes**

Removed a rare long freeze that could hit as carriages came back into range, most often just after leaving a dimensional carriage.

**Translated label in Live Eye chat**

Live Eye chat now shows a small label while translated messages are on screen, so it's clear when you're reading a translation.

- In game, it sits just above your chat and fades with it
- On the website, it shows under the chat's title, and also covers translations made by your browser
1.21.1.0.1698.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Performance ×2 · Menus & UI ×2 · Community ×1 · Train ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1696.0

**Live chat translations for everyone**

Live chat can now reach you in your own language for free, whenever someone is watching on the website. A small flag shows the language each line came from: hover it to read the original.

- Translated lines now show on their own, with the original one hover away.
- The Live Translations reward now means faster, higher quality translations.

**A note from the developer about AI**

If your feedback brings up AI, the game now replies with a short note from the developer about who made it and who writes the stories, with a link to the AI Policy.

**Better lag diagnostics**

Bug reports now say more about what slows the game down.

### 0.1695.0

**Less lag leaving dimensional carriages**

Coming back to the train after a long trip through a dimensional carriage no longer causes a run of stutters a few seconds later.

### 0.1694.0

**Fewer freezes in dimensional carriages**

Exploring dimensional carriages is smoother, with fewer freezes along the way.

### 0.1692.0

Dungeon Train's website is now at dungeon.training. Old links still work and take you to the right page.
